# Bandon Point: full text

> Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat in development on six private acres overlooking the Pacific, just minutes from Bandon Dunes on the Oregon Coast. It is expected to open in summer 2028; it is not yet built and is not yet available to book.

Elevated Design. Spectacular Scenery. Extraordinary Experience.

## The Property (owner's description)
Nestled among grassy dunes and mature trees on six private acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean, Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat just minutes from Bandon Dunes.

Part of what makes Bandon Dunes so extraordinary is the rugged beauty of its coastline, where sweeping ocean views provide a spectacular backdrop to some of the world's finest golf. With equally breathtaking 180-degree views of the Pacific and not another home in sight, Bandon Point offers the rare opportunity to enjoy that same extraordinary setting long after the round.

Which begs the question: Why stay in the woods when you can stay on the Pacific?

The view south from Bandon Point, overlooking the dramatic coastal rock formations below Sheep Ranch at Bandon Dunes.
The view north from Bandon Point toward Cape Arago.

## The Residence
Elevated Design.
Designed by the architects behind Ghost Tree Grill, Round Lake Lodge, and the Lodge at Old Macdonald, Bandon Point will bring together modern Pacific Northwest architecture, breathtaking scenery, and an extraordinary oceanfront setting just minutes from Bandon Dunes.

Conceived as a private retreat for close friends and family, the residence will feature four king bedrooms, each with a private bath and ocean view, a gourmet kitchen, and expansive walls of glass framing panoramic views of the Pacific. The thoughtful layout will be ideally suited for four golfers, each enjoying the privacy of their own bedroom and bath, yet equally inviting for couples, whether everyone plays golf or not.

## The Setting
Beyond the Fairways
For those spending a day away from the courses, Bandon Point offers plenty of ways to enjoy its extraordinary coastal setting. Walk along the beach, explore nearby mountain biking trails, or browse the shops and galleries in Old Town Bandon. Back at the residence, unwind in the oceanfront hot tub or sauna, or settle in beside the wood-burning fireplace and savor the ever-changing sights and sounds of the Pacific. With no neighboring homes or passing cars in sight, the setting offers a rare sense of peace, privacy, and connection to the coast.

Begin planning your escape to Bandon Point—a place where good people, a great game, and the beauty of the Oregon Coast come together to create an experience you'll never forget.

- Status: Expected to open in summer 2028. The residence is not yet built and is not yet available to book.
- Location: Six private acres overlooking the Pacific on the Oregon Coast, just minutes from Bandon Dunes
- Views: 180-degree views of the Pacific
- Setting: Grassy dunes and mature trees on six private acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean, with not another home in sight
- Bedrooms: Four king bedrooms, each with a private bath and ocean view
- Ideal for: Four golfers, yet equally inviting for couples, whether everyone plays golf or not
- Architecture: Modern Pacific Northwest architecture, designed by the architects behind Ghost Tree Grill, Round Lake Lodge, and the Lodge at Old Macdonald
- Amenities: Gourmet kitchen, expansive walls of glass framing panoramic ocean views, oceanfront hot tub, sauna, and wood-burning fireplace
- Distinction: The only vacation rental of its kind that is both close to the resort and located directly on the ocean

## Golf courses near Bandon Point
- Bandon Dunes (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect David McLay Kidd, opened 1999, 18 holes. The course that started it all, perched on a bluff high above the Pacific. Wide landing areas and ever present wind make it a thinker's course that plays new every round. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/bandon-dunes-golf-course/
- Pacific Dunes (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Tom Doak, opened 2001, 18 holes. Routed through shore pines out to towering sand dunes, Pacific Dunes feels discovered rather than built. Natural bunkers and rippling fairways reward precise approach shots when the wind blows. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/pacific-dunes-golf-course/
- Bandon Trails (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2005, 18 holes. Bandon Trails starts atop a massive dune, opens into a meadow, then climbs into coastal forest. It is the one resort course with no holes along the ocean, and a favorite walk for many. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/bandon-trails-golf-course/
- Old Macdonald (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Tom Doak and Jim Urbina, opened 2010, 18 holes. A tribute to Charles Blair Macdonald, built around vast greens and fierce bunkers. It asks what the classic architect would have created with the Oregon Coast as his canvas. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/old-macdonald-golf-course/
- Bandon Preserve (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2012, 13 hole par 3. A 13 hole par 3 course that begins high on a dune and rolls down toward the beach, with the Pacific behind every hole. It supports the Bandon Dunes Charitable Foundation. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/bandon-preserve-golf-course/
- Sheep Ranch (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2020, 18 holes. A mile of ocean frontage with nine greens set right along the edge of the continent. Every hole carries a view of the Pacific. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/sheep-ranch-golf-course/
- Shorty's (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Rod Whitman, Dave Axland and Keith Cutten, opened 2024, 19 hole par 3. The resort's newest course winds through rolling dunes and scattered shore pines between Bandon Trails and the ocean. It is named for Shorty Dow, the resort's first caretaker. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/golf-courses/shortys/
- The Punchbowl (Bandon Dunes Golf Resort): architect Tom Doak with Jim Urbina, opened 2014, 18 hole putting course. A 100,000 square foot putting course next to the first tee at Pacific Dunes, inspired by the Himalayas at St Andrews. It is the place to gather the group and settle the day's bets. Official page: https://bandondunesgolf.com/golf/practice/punchbowl-bandon-dunes/
- Bandon Crossings (Independent, south of Bandon): architect Dan Hixson, opened 2007, 18 holes. An 18 hole course in the gentler weather of the Bandon "banana belt," a little off the ocean. It is a challenging and more affordable round that pairs well with a resort trip. Official page: https://bandoncrossings.com/

Approximate drive times from Bandon Point will be published once the property address is confirmed.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Bandon Point?
Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat in development on six private acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean, just minutes from Bandon Dunes on the Oregon Coast. It is expected to open in summer 2028; it is not yet built and is not yet available to book.

### Where is Bandon Point?
Nestled among grassy dunes and mature trees on six private acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean, Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat just minutes from Bandon Dunes.

### When will Bandon Point open?
Bandon Point is expected to open in summer 2028. The residence is not yet built, and dates for stays have not been announced.

### Can I book a stay at Bandon Point yet?
Not yet. Bandon Point is still in development and is not yet available to book. Join the list or email info@bandonpoint.com to hear first when that changes.

### How close is Bandon Point to Bandon Dunes?
Bandon Point is just minutes from Bandon Dunes. It will be the only vacation rental of its kind that is both close to the resort and located directly on the ocean.

### How many bedrooms will Bandon Point have?
The residence will have four king bedrooms, each with a private bath and ocean view.

### Is Bandon Point a good fit for a golf group?
Yes. The layout will be ideally suited for four golfers, with four king bedrooms with private baths.

### Do we all need to play golf?
No. Bandon Point is equally inviting for couples, whether everyone plays golf or not. Walk along the beach, explore nearby mountain biking trails, or browse the shops and galleries in Old Town Bandon. Back at the residence, unwind in the oceanfront hot tub or sauna, or settle in beside the wood-burning fireplace.

### Who designed Bandon Point?
Bandon Point is designed by the architects behind Ghost Tree Grill, Round Lake Lodge, and the Lodge at Old Macdonald, and will bring together modern Pacific Northwest architecture, breathtaking scenery, and an extraordinary oceanfront setting just minutes from Bandon Dunes.

### What amenities will the home include?
The residence will feature four king bedrooms with private baths, a gourmet kitchen, and expansive walls of glass framing panoramic ocean views, plus an oceanfront hot tub, a sauna, and a wood-burning fireplace.

### How private is the property?
Very. Bandon Point occupies six private acres with 180-degree views of the Pacific and not another home in sight.

### Is Bandon Point a vacation rental near Bandon Dunes?
Yes. Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat just minutes from Bandon Dunes, and it will be the only vacation rental of its kind that is both close to the resort and located directly on the ocean. It is expected to open in summer 2028.

### Is Bandon Point an oceanfront home?
Yes. Bandon Point sits on six private acres overlooking the Pacific, with an oceanfront hot tub and expansive walls of glass framing panoramic ocean views. Guests can walk along the beach.

### What size group is Bandon Point best for?
Bandon Point has four king bedrooms with private baths. The layout will be ideally suited for four golfers, yet equally inviting for couples, whether everyone plays golf or not.

### Is Bandon Point part of Bandon Dunes Golf Resort?
No. Bandon Point is a privately owned property near Bandon Dunes Golf Resort.

### What architectural style will Bandon Point be?
Modern Pacific Northwest architecture, designed by the architects behind Ghost Tree Grill, Round Lake Lodge, and the Lodge at Old Macdonald.

### Which golf courses are near Bandon Point?
Bandon Dunes Golf Resort has five 18 hole courses (Bandon Dunes, Pacific Dunes, Bandon Trails, Old Macdonald and Sheep Ranch), two par 3 courses (Bandon Preserve and Shorty's) and the Punchbowl putting course. Bandon Crossings is an independent 18 hole course south of Bandon.

### How do I book tee times near Bandon Point?
Tee times are booked directly with each course.

### How far is Bandon Point from each course?
Bandon Point is just minutes from Bandon Dunes. Approximate drive times to each course will be published once the property address is confirmed.
